audit.badge_rule: An ayah badge is part of the physical line where the badge is actually printed. The badge never creates an extra line. If a badge for ayah N appears at the end/start of a physical line, that same physical line belongs to ayah N. A badge belonging to the previous ayah at the beginning/end of a line does not make that line belong to the next ayah unless the next ayah's text is also physically on it.

badge_policy.previous_ayah_badge_at_line_boundary: A badge belongs to the ayah printed in that badge. If it is physically on a line by itself or at the edge of a line, that physical line belongs to the previous ayah, not automatically to the next ayah.
badge_policy.next_ayah_requires_physical_presence: The next ayah gets that line only if its text is physically present on the same line.
